title: Sprint 3 — Task CRUD Operations & User Isolation
description: Implement task creation, listing, and single retrieval while enforcing strict per-user data ownership.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 - Create New Task API
tickets.description:
Implement `POST /api/tasks` allowing an authenticated user to create a task.

### Request Header
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`

### Request Body
```json
{
  "title": "Complete Flask Lab",
  "description": "Finish all 4 sprints with passing tests"
}
```

### Requirements
1. Protect endpoint with `@token_required`.
2. Validate that `title` is non-empty. Return `400 Bad Request` if title is missing.
3. Create new task associated with `current_user.id`.
4. Return `201 Created` with `{"message": "Task created successfully", "task": {...}}`.
learning_objectives: Associate created entities with authenticated users.
Implement payload validation for required fields.

tasks.title: Validate non-empty title in request payload.
Persist task to database with `user_id` set to current user.

common_mistakes: Allowing the client to pass arbitrary `user_id` in the request body instead of taking it from the JWT token.
hints: Always use `current_user.id` to set `user_id` on the new `Task` instance.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 - List Authenticated User Tasks
tickets.description:
Implement `GET /api/tasks` returning all tasks belonging to the authenticated user.

### Request Header
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`

### Requirements
1. Protect endpoint with `@token_required`.
2. Query only tasks where `user_id == current_user.id`.
3. Return `200 OK` with JSON `{"tasks": [...]}` containing an array of serialized task objects.
learning_objectives: Filter queries by authenticated user identifier.
Serialize collections of ORM models into JSON arrays.
Ensure data isolation between multiple users.

tasks.title: Return JSON list of tasks with HTTP 200.

common_mistakes: Querying all tasks (`Task.query.all()`) instead of filtering by `user_id`.
Returning un-serialized SQLAlchemy objects causing JSON serialization errors.
hints: List comprehension: `[task.to_dict() for task in tasks]`.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 - Retrieve Task by ID with Ownership Authorization
tickets.description:
Implement `GET /api/tasks/<id>` to retrieve the details of a specific task.

### Requirements
1. Protect endpoint with `@token_required`.
2. Find task by `id`. If no task exists, return `404 Not Found`.
3. **Ownership Check**: If the task belongs to a different user, return `404 Not Found` (or `403 Forbidden`) with `{"error": "Task not found"}` to prevent resource enumeration.
4. If the task belongs to `current_user`, return `200 OK` with `{"task": task.to_dict()}`.
learning_objectives: Implement single-resource REST endpoints with URL parameters.
Enforce horizontal authorization / access control checks.

tasks.title: Retrieve task by primary key from URL parameter.
Return HTTP 404 on missing or unauthorized task access.

common_mistakes: Returning tasks of other users without checking `user_id` (IDOR security flaw).
Crashing with 500 when non-existent IDs are queried.
hints: Query using `Task.query.filter_by(id=task_id, user_id=current_user.id).first()` for atomic lookup and authorization.
